requirements.description: The Healing Sky homepage should load successfully and display the main navigation controls, including Sign In and Join Healing Sky.
Clicking the Sign In control in the Healing Sky main navigation should open the Sign In menu and display both the I'm a Client option and the I'm a Provider option.
With the Sign In menu open, selecting the I'm a Client option should open the client sign-in page or client authentication interface.
The client sign-in page should load successfully and display the Client Login heading, Email field, OTP delivery options for Email and SMS, and the Log in button.
The client sign-in page should allow the user to select Email as the OTP delivery method.
Using the configured valid client test email, selecting Email as the OTP delivery method, and clicking Log in should open the client OTP verification screen.
The client OTP verification screen should display the Enter Verification Code heading, OTP entry fields, resend code control or countdown, Verify button, and Back control.
Entering the configured client test OTP bypass value into the OTP verification fields and clicking Verify should successfully authenticate the client and open the authenticated client dashboard.
After successful client authentication and dashboard verification, the user should be able to log out successfully and return to the public or client sign-in interface.
From the Healing Sky homepage, opening the Sign In menu and selecting the I'm a Provider option should open the provider sign-in page or provider authentication interface.
From the Healing Sky homepage, clicking Join Healing Sky in the main navigation should open the joining options and display the Join as a Client option.
With the Join Healing Sky options open, selecting Join as a Client should open the client registration page or client registration interface.
The client registration interface should display the information fields and controls required to begin client registration.
The client registration interface should provide a clear action such as Continue, Next, Register, or Submit to proceed with registration.
From the Healing Sky homepage, clicking the Join Healing Sky call-to-action in the homepage hero section should open the joining options.
With the joining options opened from the homepage hero section, the Join as a Client option should be displayed.
With the homepage hero joining options open, selecting Join as a Client should open the client registration page or client registration interface.
